[borealis] ([Padus petraea]), often with [Sorbus aucuparia] ssp. [glabrata], [Betula carpatica], [Lonicera nigra].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Subalpine ericaceous brush
description: Thickets or brushes of the subalpine zone of the Alps, the Carpathians, the Jura dominated by large [Vaccinium] shrubs, often accompanied by tall herbs characteristic of the subalpine tall herb communities (unit 37.8).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Rhodope [Potentilla fruticosa] thickets
description: Closed formations dominated by [Potentilla fruticosa] of the 1550 metre level in the [Picea abies] and [Pinus sylvestris] belt of the west Rhodope mountains of Bulgaria.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Oroboreal birch scrub
description: Very low scrubs formed in exposed situations by otherwise thicket-building birches of boreal mountains and mountainous regions, in particular [Betula pubescens] ssp. [czerepanovii] ([Betula tortuosa], [Betula pubescens] ssp. [tortuosa], [Betula kusmisscheffii]) of Iceland, Greenland, the boreal mountains of Scandinavia, the Urals, or [Betula ermani] and [Betula middendorffii] of the Far-East, dwarf facies of the woods and thickets of unit 41.B7. Subdivisions of unit 41.B7 can be used to define precise communities.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hedgehog-heaths
description: Primary cushion heaths of the high, dry mountains of the Mediterranean and Irano-Turanian regions, with low, cushion-forming, often spiny shrubs, in particular of genera [Acantholimon], [Astragalus], [Erinacea], [Vella], [Bupleurum], [Ptilotrichum], [Genista], [Echinospartum], [Anthyllis], and various composites and labiates; secondary, zoogenic cushion heaths of the same regions, either downslope extensions of the high-altitude formations, and dominated by the same species, or specifically montane or steppic, often [Genista]-dominated in the Mediterranean region. Excluded are cushion-heaths of thermo-Mediterranean lowlands (unit 33) and of deserts and semideserts (unit 7).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Pyrenean hedgehog-heaths
description: [Echinospartum horridum] formations of dry slopes of the supra-Mediterranean zone of the southern Pyrenees; accompanying the dense, spiny cushions are [Juniperus hemisphaerica], [Buxus sempervirens], [Ononis fruticosa], [Arctostaphylos uva-ursi] ssp. [crassifolia] and [Pinus sylvestris].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cordilleran hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of the Cordillera Central and adjacent areas dominated by diverse forms of [Echinospartum].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Gredos hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean heaths of the Sierra de Gredos dominated by the endemic [Echinospartum lusitanicu] ssp. [barnadesii].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Bejar-Peña de Francia hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean heaths of the Sierra de Bejar and Pe¤a de Francia dominated by [Echinospartum ibericum] ssp. [pulviniformis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Estrela hedgehog-heaths
description: Relict heaths of highly xeric upper supra-Mediterranean and oro-Mediterranean stations of the Serra da Estrela dominated by [Echinospartum ibericum] ssp. [pulviniformis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Western Cordilleran secondary hedgehog-heaths
description: Secondary [Echinospartum lusitanicum-Genista histrix] hedgehog-heaths developed on skeletal soils of the supra-Mediterranean zone of the western Cordillera Central and surrounding areas.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Nevadan hedgehog-heaths
description: Highly developed hedgehog formations of the Sierra Nevada with [Erinacea anthyllis], [Vella spinosa], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [nevadensis], [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [granatensis] ([Astragalus boissieri]), [Ptilotrichum spinosum], [Bupleurum spinosum], [Genista baetica]. Associated dwarf suffrutescent formations of high slopes and crests.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Lower Nevadan hedgehog-heaths
description: Supra-Mediterranean (lower xeroacanthic) hedgehog-heaths occupying mainly the 1700-2000 m altitudinal range, often rich in [Bupleurum spinosum], with [Vella spinosa], [Erinacea anthyllis] or [Echinospartum boissieri].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Middle Nevadan hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean (higher xeroacanthic) hedgehog-heaths occupying mainly the 2000-2300 m altitudinal range, with [Vella spinosa], [Erinacea anthyllis], [Ptilotrichum spinosum], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [nevadensis], [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [granatensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Upper Nevadan hedgehog-heaths
description: Upper oro-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths occupying mainly the 2300-2600 m altitudinal range, with [Erinacea anthyllis], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [nevadensis], [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [granatensis], [Juniperus nana] and [Juniperus sabina] ssp. [humilis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Nevadan dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Dwarf suffrutescent formations of windswept crests and slopes on very superficial soils.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Siliceous Nevadan dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of base-rich siliceous soils at 2600-2900 m with [Sideritis glacialis], [Arenaria pungens], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [nevadensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Calcareous Nevadan dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of white-tomentose dwarf cushions developed on calcareous soils (Trevenque, Dornajo, Dilar) with [Andryala agardhii], [Erodium boissieri], [Scabiosa pulsatilloides], [Santolina elegans], [Globularia spinosa], [Pterocephalus spathulatus], [Helianthemum pannosum].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Nevadan [Genista] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Genista baetica]-dominated hedgehog-heaths, often with [Juniperus nana] and [Genista purgans], of siliceous soils.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Franco-Iberian hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean and montane hedgehog-heaths of other Iberian ranges and of southern France.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Erinacea] hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean [Erinacea]-dominated and related hedgehog-heaths.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Baetic [Erinacea-Vella] hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of the Baetic and sub-Baetic ranges and of the southern Iberian Range, dominated by [Erinacea anthyllis] and/or by [Vella spinosa], [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [granatensis], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [nevadensis], [Bupleurum spinosum], [Ptilotrichum spinosum], developed in particular in the sierras de Segura, de Cazorla, de Alcaraz, Tejeda, Harana, Magina, de Baza, La Sagra, de Gador, Maria and on a few summits of the Serrania de Ronda.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Iberian Range [Erinacea] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Erinacea anthyllis]-dominated hedgehog-heaths of the Iberian Range (Teruel, Cuenca, Guadalajara, Soria), often in altitudinal contact with [Genista pumila] formations.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Maestrazgo [Erinacea-Genista] hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths with [Genista hispanica] ssp. [hispanica] and/or [Erinacea anthyllis] of the Maestrazgo, eastern spur of the Iberian Range under maritime influence.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Southeastern [Erinacea] hedgehog-heath
description: Hedgehog-heaths with [Genista lobelii] ssp. [longipes], [Erinacea anthyllis], [Vella spinosa] of the sub-Baetic Aitana and Mariola ranges in the arid southeast.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Southeastern [Daphne] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations with [Daphne oleoides] ssp. [hispanica] of the mountains of the arid souteast.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Peri-Nevadan dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean, and sometimes supra-Mediterranean, formations of dwarf white-tomentose, cushion-forming suffrutescents of the high sub-Baetic and Baetic ranges; characteristic are [Andryala agardhii], [Convolvulus boissieri], [Hippocrepis squamata] ssp. [eriocarpa], [Pterocephalus spathulatus] and [Thymus granatensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cazorla dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of the Sierras de Cazorla, Segura, Alcaraz, Taibilla of the high Guadalquivir basin, with [Erodium cazorlanum], [Scorzonera albicans].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Baza-Tejeda-Ronda dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of the sierras Tejeda, Almijara, la Torrecilla, Harana, Baza, la Sagra, Cazulas, Lapeza and of the Serrania de Ronda with [Anthyllis vulneraria] ssp. [argyrophylla], [Anthyllis tejedensis], [Helianthemum viscidulum].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Magina dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of the Sierra de Magina with [Helianthemum pannosum] ssp. [frigidulum], [Lithodora nitida] and [Viola cazorlensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Maria-Maimon dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of the sierras Maria and Maimon with [Centaurea baetica], [Sideritis stachydioides], [Alyssum cadevallianum].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Echinospartum boissieri] hedgehog-heaths
description: Mostly supra-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths colonizing superficial, eroded soils and windswept stations of calcareous Baetic and sub-Baetic ranges, comprising many cushion plants and generally physiognomically dominated by the large hemispherical shrubs of [Echinospartum boissieri].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alcaraz [Echinospartum] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of the Sierra de Alcaraz, sometimes including [Erinacea anthyllis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Gador [Echinospartum] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of the 1300-1900 m altitudinal range in the Sierra de Gador, often with [Erinacea anthyllis] or [Ulex parviflorus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Baetic [Echinospartum] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations developed in the 800-1400 m altitudinal range of other Baetic and sub-Baetic ranges, often, in the higher mountains, immediately below [Erinacetalia] communities.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Catalano-Valencian [Erinacea] hedgehog-heaths
description: Unommon hedgehog-heaths with [Erinacea anthyllis] and [Anthyllis montana], and related cushion plant formations, colonizing windswept stations with skeletal soil of the Mediterranean mountains of northeastern Spain (Montsant, Llaveria, Cardo, Maestrazgo septentrional, Beceite; Montserrat; Bergueda, Solsones).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista] cushion-heaths
description: Mostly supra-Mediterranean hedgehog garrigues and heaths physiognomically dominated by small, hemispherical [Genista spp.].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Pyreneo-Cantabrian cushion-heaths
description: Cushion-heaths dominated by [Genista hispanica] ssp. [occidentalis] or [Genista hystrix] ssp. [legionensis], often with [Erica vagans], [Arctostaphylos uva-ursi] ssp. [crassifolia] or [Lithodora diffusa], characteristic of the Pyreneen-Cantabrian system, where they may occur from the collinar to the subalpine level.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista sanabrensis] cushion-heaths
description: Heaths dominated by the cushions of [Genista sanabrensis], with [Erica umbellata] and [Calluna vulgaris], occupying crests of southern Galicio-Leonese mountains at about 1800 m (cf. 31.2431).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista pumila] cushion-heaths
description: Cushion heaths dominated by [Genista pumila] ssp. [pumila] of windswept plateaux and crests of the Meseta and of the northern and southern Iberian Range.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista scorpius] cushion-heaths
description: Meseta hedgehog-heaths with [Genista scorpius], rich in cushion-forming small shrubs.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista pseudopilosa] cushion-heaths
description: Unarmed [Genista pseudopilosa]-dominated hedgehog-heaths with [Erinacea anthyllis] and other cushion plants of the sierras de Alcaraz and Segura.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista lobelii] and [G. pulchella] cushion-heaths
description: [Genista lobelii] and [Genista pulchella] hedgehog-heaths of windswept hilltops of southeastern France.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Collinar [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Local meso- and supra-Mediterranean [Astragalus] formations of the Spanish Meseta.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Dueran [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Supra-Mediterranean [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [granatensis] ([Astragalus boissieri]) formations of pastoral runs of the left bank of the middle Duero (Soria, Segovia) and of the highlands of Atienza (Guadalajara).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Southern Mesetan [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Meso- and supra-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths with [Astragalus clusii] ([Astragalus tumidus]) of the southern Meseta, from La Mancha to the Baetic hills of eastern Andalusia (Orce, Sagra, Baza, Maria), with [Paronychia aretioides], [Genista pumila] ssp. [mugronensis], [Genista scorpius].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Summital Balearic labiate hedgehog-heaths
description: Cushion-forming communities of high altitudes and wind-exposed plateaux of the Balearics, dominated by [Teucrium subspinosum].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Mallorcan hedgehog-heaths
description: Cushion-forming communities of the high altitudes of the Sierra Tramuntana of Mallorca, rich in endemics, among them [Teucrium subspinosum], [Teucrium asiaticum], [Pastinaca lucida], [Thymelaea velutina] and [Paeonia cambessedesii].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Menorcan hedgehog-heaths
description: Cushion-forming communities of wind-exposed plateaux and hills of Menorca with [Cistus creticus] and [Teucrium subspinosum] var. [spinescens].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyrno-Sardinian hedgehog-heaths
description: Expanses of small, compact bushes with [Astragalus sirinicus] ssp. [genargenteus], [Rosa serafinii], [Anthyllis hermanniae], [Thymus herba-barona], [Cerastium boissieri], [Genista salzmannii], [Genista corsica], [Berberis aetnensis], [Prunus prostrata] and [Daphne oleoides], of Sardinian and Corsican mountains.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Astragalus genargenteus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean [Astragalus sirinicus] ssp. [genargenteus] hedgehog-heaths of the Gennargentu and Monte Albo in Sardinia and of the high mountains of Corsica.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyrno-Sardinian [Euphorbia] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of windswept crests of Corsica and Sardinia dominated by the low spiny cushions of [Euphorbia spinosa].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyrno-Sardinian [Thymus] cushion-heaths
description: Formations of the mountains of Corsica and Sardinia dominated by the hemispherical cushions of the endemic [Thymus herba-barona].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyrno-Sardinian [Genista] hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of high mountains of Corsica and Sardinia and secondary heaths of the montane level dominated by [Genista salzmannii] (including [Genista salzmannii] var. [lobelioides]) or [Genista corsica].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyrno-Sardinian [Berberis] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of the mountains of Corsica and Sardinia dominated by [Berberis aetnensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyrno-Sardinian [Anthyllis] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of the mountains of Corsica and Sardinia dominated by [Anthyllis hermanniae].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Mount Etna hedgehog-heaths
description: Lava-colonising hedgehog-heaths of Mount Etna formed by cushions of [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [siculus], with [Berberis aetnensis], [Juniperus hemisphaerica], [Genista aetnensis], [Adenocarpus bivonae], [Viola aethnensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Madonie and Apennine hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths formed by [Astragalus spp.] or [Genista spp.], of the mountains of the southern Italian peninsula and Sicily, except Etna.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Madonie [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths of the Madonie with [Astragalus granatensis] ssp. [nebrodensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Sila-Aspromonte [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Oro-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths of the Sila and Aspromonte with [Astragalus parnassi] ssp. [calabrus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Apennine [Astragalus sirinicus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths with [Astragalus sirinicus] ssp. [sirinicus] of the central and southern Apennines, south to northern Calabria.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Madonie [Genista cupanii] hedgehog-heaths
description: Montane [Genista cupanii]-dominated hedgehog-heaths of the Madonie.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Gargano [Genista] hedgehog-heaths
description: Montane hedgehog-heaths of Monte Gargano with [Genista sylvestris] ssp. [dalmatica].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Helleno-Balkanic sylvatic [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths occupying situations peripheral to the main range of the alti- and oromediterranean hedgehog-heath communities of high Hellenic mountains (units 31.79 and 31.7A), mostly dominated by [Astragalus angustifolius], characteristic, in particular, of zoogenous clearings within the forest belt of southern Greek mountains and of regions of irradiation of Mediterranean communities within the hills and mountains of the Moesian zone.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Southern Hellenic montane hedgehog heaths
description: Hedgehog-heath facies of mostly secondary grassland-scrubland communities replacing [Abies cephalonica] forests in the 1500-1800 m altitudinal range of Peloponnese mountains, in particular, Taygetos, Parnon and Kyllini, and of southern mainland Greek mountains, including the southern Pindus and the Thessalian mountains, composed of [Stipa pulcherrima] and [Morina persica], with bushes and cushion-shaped perennials including [Astragalus angustifolius], [Daphne oleoides], [Juniperus hemisphaerica], [Berberis cretica], [Anthemis montana], [Ribes uva-crispa], [Prunus cocomilia].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Moesian [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths, mostly secondary, scattered, mostly in the xero-thermic oak belt, in the mountains of northern Greece and in regions of Mediterranean influence of the mountains and hills of the central Balkan peninsula, in particular, in the northern Pindus, in the Pelagonides, in the Moeso-Macedonian Ranges, in the Rhodopides and in the foothills of the Balkan Range. [Thymus striatus], [Satureja montana], [Artemisia alba], [Agropogon pectiniforme], [Rhodax canus], [Teucrium chamaedrys], [Teucrium montanum], [Sideritis montana], [Festuca thracica], [Hyacinethella leucophaea], [Sternbergia colchiciflora], [Asphodelus albus], [Adonis flammea] participate in the [Astragalus] communities.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic oro-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths developed on relatively humus-rich rendziniform soils at or above treeline, in the 1700-2200 m altitudinal range of high Greek mountains; hedgehog-heath facies of associated grasslands; similar, impoverished formations descending into the forest belts of the same mountains, with the exception of those of the Peloponnese, where they are replaced by distinctive formations, listed under 31.78.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic tragacanth hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of the Taygetos, Kyllini, Chelmos, Parnassus, Vardousia, Giona and calcareous central and northern Pindus, dominated by the large hemispherical tussocks of the tragacanths [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [rumelicus], and/or [Astragalus parnassi], and with [Marrubium velutinum], [Marrubium cyllenaeum], [Juniperus hemisphaerica], [Daphne oleoides], [Eryngium amethystinum], [Sideritis clandestina], [Cirsium hypopsilum] ([Cirsium cylleneum]).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Southern Peloponnese tragacanth hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [rumelicus] heaths of the southern Peloponnese.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Kyllini-Chelmos tragacanth hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus parnassi] ssp. [cylleneus] and [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [rumelicus] heaths of Kyllini and Chelmos.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic mainland tragacanth hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [rumelicus] and/or [Astragalus parnassi] ssp. [parnassi] heaths of high mountains of the mainland of Greece.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Oro-Hellenic [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus angustifolius] heaths of high Greek mountains, with [Marrubium thessalum] or [Marrubium velutinum] ssp. [haussknechtii].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Olympus [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations of the Olympus system dominated by [Astragalus angustifolius].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Pindus [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of the Pindus dominated by [Astragalus angustifolius] (or [Astragalus sirinicus]).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic cushion-heaths
description: Cushion formations of high Greek mountains not dominated by thorny, tussock-forming species of [Astragalus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic [Daphne oleoides] cushion-heaths
description: Formations of high Greek mountains dominated by small bushes of [Daphne oleoides], usually accompanied by stripped grassland components (36.437).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic [Buxus sempervirens] cushion-heaths
description: Formations dominated by low mats of [Buxus sempervirens], characteristic of middle slopes of Greek mountains, in particular Olympus.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Hellenic alti-Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths
description: Shrubby formations of the high mountains of the Peloponnese, of the southern mainland Greek mountains and of the Thessalian Olympus system, colonizing the altitudinal range immediately above that occupied by the communities of 31.79, as well as stony slopes with shallow soil, loose screes and humus-deficient soils within the main 1700-2200 m range of these communities. Included are true spiny hedgehog-heaths, cushiony formations of dwarf suffrutescents and bush-dominated facies of stripped grasslands. [Astragalus angustifolius], [Acantholimon androsaceum], [Astragalus lacteus], [Convolvulus cochlearis], [Rindera graeca], [Aster alpinus], [Globularia stygia], [Minuartia stellata], [Erysimum pusillum], [Thymus teucrioides], [Alyssum kionae], [Paronychia kapela], [Thymus hirsutus], [Anthyllis aurea], [Achillea ageratifolia], [Sideritis scardica], [Linum flavum], [Thymus boissieri], [Sesleria coerulans] are characteristic.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alti-Hellenic [Astragalus] hedgehog-heaths
description: Shrubby formations of the high levels of the mountains of the Peloponnese, of the southern mainland Greek mountains and of the Thessalian Olympus system,  dominated by the dense tussocks of [Astragalus angustifolius].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alti-Hellenic [Minuartia] cushion-heaths
description: Shrubby formations of the high levels of the Peloponnese and of the southern mainland Greek mountains, dominated by the large, domed mats of [Minuartia stellata].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alti-Hellenic dwarf cushion-heaths
description: Formations of the high reaches of Greek mountains, rich in dwarf suffrutescents.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alti-Hellenic bushy grasslands
description: Bushy facies of the high altitude stripped grasslands (36.437) of the high mountains of the Peloponnese, of the southern mainland Greek mountains and of the Thessalian Olympus system.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cretan hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of high mountains of Crete, in the 1500-2500 m altitudinal range, with [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [creticus], [Astragalus angustifolius], [Acantholimon androsaceum], [Atraphaxis billardieri], [Berberis cretica], [Chamaecytisus creticus], [Daphne oleoides], [Prunus prostrata], [Euphorbia acanthothamnos], [Verbascum spinosum], [Sideritis syriaca], [Satureja spinosa], [Asperula idaea], [Rhamnus prunifolius], [Pimpinella tragium], [Acinos alpinus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cretan tragacanth hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [creticus]-dominated hedgehog-heaths of the Psiloriti and Dikti mountains of central and eastern Crete.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cretan [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus angustifolius]-dominated hedgehog-heaths of the Lefka Ori, Psiloriti and Dikti mountains of Crete.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cretan [Chamaecytisus] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Chamaecytisus creticus]-dominated hedgehog-heaths of Crete.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Eastern Cretan hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of the Dikti and Psiloritis mountains of Crete, in the 1500-2500 m altitudinal range, dominated by species other than [Astragalus creticus] ssp. [creticus], [Astragalus angustifolius], [Chamaecytisus creticus], in particular, by [Acantholimon androsaceum], [Satureja spinosa], [Berberis cretica].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Western Cretan hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of the Lefka Ori of Crete, in the 1500-2500 m altitudinal range, dominated by species other than [Astragalus angustifolius] or [Chamaecytisus creticus], in particular, by [Acantholimon androsaceum], [Satureja spinosa], [Berberis cretica].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Aegean summital hedgehog-heaths
description: Isolated, endemic-rich, mostly summital hedgehog-heaths of calcareous mountains of Aegean islands and Mount Athos.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Aegean tragacanth hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of mountain summits of Aegean islands, characterised by large tragacanths.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Kerki tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Kerki summit community of Samos with [Astragalus creticus] var. [samius], [Astragalus angustifolius], [Acantholimon androsaceum], [Atraphaxis billardieri], [Centaurea spinosa] var. [tragacanthoides], [Centaurea xylobasis], [Genista fasselata] var. [subsericans], [Prunus prostrata], [Silene urvillei], [Lithospermum hispidulum], [Thymus squarrosus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Ambelos tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Ambelos summit community of Samos with [Astragalus ptilodes], [Acantholimon androsaceum], [Prunus prostrata], [Silene urvillei].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Chios tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Formations with [Astragalus trojanus] var. [chius] of the highlands of Chios.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Lesbos tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Petrovuni summit community of Lesbos with [Astragalus parnassi] ("[Astragalus lesbiacus]").
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Samothrace tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Phanga summit community of Samothrace with [Astragalus parnassi] var. [samothracius] and [Genista fasselata] var. [subsericans].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Athos tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Athos communities with [Astragalus monachorum] and [Astragalus angustifolius] ssp. [pungens].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Euboa tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Delphi community of Euboa with [Astragalus creticus] var. [euboicus], [Daphne oleoides], [Prunus prostrata].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Aegean [Astragalus angustifolius] hedgehog-heaths
description: Communities characterised by the dense tussocks of [Astragalus angustifolius].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Lesbos Olympus hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Olympus summit community of Lesbos with [Astragalus angustifolius] and [Silene urvillei].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Thasos hedgehog-heath
description: Mount Agia Illias summit community of Thasos.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Southern Hellenic [Genista acanthoclada] hedgehog-heaths
description: Formations dominated by hemispherical shrubs of [Genista acanthoclada] of the middle levels (about 800-1200 m) of mountains and plateaux of the Peloponnese.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Astragalus sempervirens] hedgehog-heaths
description: [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [sempervirens], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [muticus], [Astragalus sempervirens] ssp. [cephalonicus] formations of the southern Alps, the eastern Pyrenees, Iberia, the Apennines and Greece, transitional between the alpine and subalpine heaths of unit 31.4 and the true Mediterranean hedgehog-heaths of unit 31.7.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Canarian cushion-heaths
description: Open formations dominated by broom-like plants of the montane zone (above 1900 m) of the Canary Islands, with many endemic species.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Tenerife cushion-heaths
description: Formations of Tenerife with [Spartocytisus supranubius], [Adenocarpus viscosus] var. [viscosus], [Descurainia bourgaena], [Pterocephalus lasiospermus], [Erysimum scoparium], [Scrophularia glabrata], [Nepeta teydea], [Echium wildpretii], [Echium auberianum], [Cheirolophus teydis], [Plantago webbii], [Sideritis cretica], [Argyranthemum teneriffae], [Pimpinella cumbrae], [Arrhenatherum calderae].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: La Palma cushion-heaths
description: Formations of La Palma with [Adenocarpus viscosus] var. [spartioides], the very rare [Genista benehoavensis] and [Descurainia gilba], [Pterocephalus porphyranthus], [Viola palmensis], [Echium wildpretii], [Echium gentianoides], [Micromeria lasiophylla] ssp. [palmensis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: North African hedgehog-heaths
description: Primary and secondary cushion heaths of the altimediterranean and oromediterranean levels of the Tell Atlas, the Middle Atlas, the Grand Atlas, the Anti-Atlas and the Saharan Atlas.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cyprian hedgehog-heaths
description: Summital community of the Chionistra, in the Troodos group, developed above the tree limit, at about 1900-1950 m above sealevel, with [Berberis cretica], [Sorbus aria] ssp. [cretica], [Rosa canina] ssp. [dumalis], [Juniperus foetidissima] and tragacanthic shrubs, in particular, [Astragalus echinus], [Alyssum troodii], [Teucrium cyprium], [Nepeta troodi], [Satureja troodii]. Other highly restricted endemics include [Onosma troodii], [Scorzonera troodea].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Mediterraneo-Anatolian hedgehog-heaths
description: Tragacanthic communities of the Taurus, the Antitaurus, the Amanus, the Aegean ranges of western Anatolia, the Lebanon mountains, Mount Hermon, the Jebel Druz and the mountains of northern Sinai, with rich communities dominated by numerous species of genera [Astragalus] and [Acantholimon], acccompanied by, among others, [Berberis cretica], [Daphne oleoides].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Taurus hedgehog-heaths
description: Tragacanthic communities of the Taurus and the Antitaurus, dominated by several species of genus [Acantholimon] and by [Astragalus angustifolius] and [Astragalus pannosus], among others.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Aegeo-Anatolian hedgehog-heaths
description: Tragacanthic communities of the Aegean ranges of western Anatolia, dominated by species of genera [Astragalus] and [Acantholimon], acccompanied by, among others, [Daphne oleoides].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Amanus hedgehog-heaths
description: Tragacanthic communities of the Amanus, extremely rich in species, in particular of genus [Astragalus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Levantine hedgehog-heaths
description: Tragacanthic communities of the Lebanon mountains, Mount Hermon, the Jebel Druz, dominated by over 15 species of genus [Astragalus], several species of genus [Acantholimon] and by [Berberis cretica].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Sinai hedgehog-heaths
description: Tragacanthic communities of the mountains of northern Sinai, dominated by a very limited number of species of genus [Astragalus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Western central Eurasian hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of hills, plateaux and mountains of the steppe and substeppe zones of western central Eurasia, west to eastern Bulgaria and central Anatolia.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Northern Thracian tragacanth hedgehog-heath
description: Endemic [Astragalus aitosensis] ([Astragalus arnacantha], [Astracantha aitosensis]) formation of Bulgaria, restricted to a few sites of the xerothermic oak belt, on steep, south-facing slopes of the Aitoska hills, southeastern spur of the Balkan Range onto the Northern Thracian plain.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Central Anatolian hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of hills, plateaux and mountains of the steppe and substeppe zones of central Anatolia.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Irano-Afghan hedgehog-heaths
description: Hedgehog-heaths of hills, plateaux and mountains of the steppe and substeppe zones of northeastern Anatolia, Iran, Irak and Afghanistan.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Himalayan hedgehog-heaths
description: Primary and secondary cushion heaths of high, dry mountains and plateaux of the Himalayan system and its Palaearctic periphery.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Western Palaearctic temperate thickets
description: Pre- and postforest formations, mostly deciduous, of Atlantic, sub-Atlantic or subcontinental affinities, characteristic of the western Palaearctic deciduous forest zone, but also colonizing cool, moist or disturbed stations of the mediterranean evergreen forest zone.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Medio-European rich-soil thickets
description: Deciduous thickets of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe formed by [Prunus spinosa], [Prunus mahaleb], [Rosa spp.], [Cornus mas], [Cornus sanguinea], [Sorbus aria], [Crataegus spp.], [Lonicera xylosteum], [Rhamnus catharticus], [Rhamnus alpinus], [Clematis vitalba], [Ligustrum vulgare], [Viburnum lantana], [Viburnum opulus], [Rubus spp.], [Amelanchier ovalis], [Cotoneaster integerrimus], [Cotoneaster nebrodensis], [Pyrus pyraster], [Malus sylvestris], [Euonymus europaeus], [Corylus avellana], [Ulmus minor], [Acer campestre], [Acer monspessulanum], [Carpinus betulus] characteristic of forest edges, hedges and woodland recolonization, developed on soils relatively rich in nutrients, neutral or calcareous, substitution communities of the [Carpinion betuli] (units 41.21-41.29), [Quercion pubescenti-petraeae] (unit 41.71) and [Fagion sylvaticae] (units 41.11-41.16) climax forests. The communities of unit 31.81 extend south to northern Iberia and northern Italy, east to Austria, Slovakia, Poland and northern Moldavia.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Blackthorn-bramble scrub
description: Mesophile, often luxuriant, shrub communities of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe east to Poland, northern Moldavia, Slovakia and Austria, characteristic of [Carpinion] forest edges and substitution formations with, among others, [Prunus spinosa], [Carpinus betulus], [Crataegus spp.], [Sambucus nigra], [Rosa spp.], [Viburnum opulus], [Rubus spp.] Included are species-poor [Prunus spinosa] thickets, such as British [Prunus spinosa-Rubus fruticosus] scrub and corresponding mainland formations with [Rubus fruticosus], [Rubus elegantispinosus], [Rubus bifrons], [Rubus armeniacus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Sub-Atlantic blackthorn-bramble scrub
description: [Prunus spinosa], [Carpinus betulus], [Crataegus spp.], [Rosa spp.], [Rubus spp]. communities of the Western European and western and northern Central European mainland east to Poland, northern Moldavia, Slovakia, Austria and Slovenia, under sub-Atlantic or subcontinental climates.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Atlantic blackthorn-bramble scrub
description: [Prunus spinosa], [Rubus spp.] communities of the British Isles and other areas of strongly Atlantic climates. [Ulex europaeus], [Hedera helix], [Lonicera periclymenum] and [Pteridium aquilinum] are often present.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Blackthorn-privet scrub
description: Shrub communities of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe east to Poland, northern Moldavia, Slovakia and Austria, developed on the usually calcareous, dry soils with warm exposure characteristic of the [Quercion pubescenti-petraeae] and of xeric, calciphilous forms of the [Carpinion], with, among others, [Prunus spinosa], [Ligustrum vulgare], [Viburnum lantana], [Cornus mas], [Rhamnus catharticus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Atlantic and medio-European blackthorn-privet scrub
description: Thermophile shrub communities of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe east to Poland, Slovakia, Austria and Slovenia, occupying the domaine of the [Carpinion] and northern irradiations of [Quercetalia pubescenti-petraeae] communities.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Medio-European blackthorn-privet scrub
description: Thermophile shrub communities of the mainland of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe east to Poland, Slovakia, Austria and Slovenia, formed by [Prunus spinosa], [Ligustrum vulgare], [Viburnum lantana], [Cornus mas], [Rhamnus catharticus], [Crataegus spp.], [Carpinus betulus] under sub-Atlantic or subcontinental climates.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Atlantic hawthorn-ivy scrub
description: Thermophile shrub communities of the British Isles and areas of strongly Atlantic climates differing from unit 31.81211 in particular in the scarcity of [Carpinus betulus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Atlantic calcicline scrub
description: Widespread neutrophilous to calciphilous, species-rich thorny scrub and seminatural hedge communities of the British Isles, with [Crataegus monogyna], [Hedera helix], [Rubus spp.], [Prunus spinosa], [Fraxinus excelsior].  Included are the [Hedera helix]-[Urtica dioica], [Mercurialis perennis] and [Brachypodium sylvaticum] subcommunities of the [Crataegus monogyna]-[Hedera helix] scrub.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Wayfaring-tree chalk scrub
description: Species-rich communities mostly of southeastern England, characterized by the abundance of [Viburnum lantana], [Ligustrum vulgare], [Cornus sanguinea], [Tamus communis] and [Clematis vitalba], the frequency of [Taxus baccata] saplings and [Juniperus communis].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Sub-Mediterranean blackthorn-privet scrub
description: Xero-thermophile shrub communities of Western Europe and western Central Europe, occupying the southern part of the west European range of unit 31.812, within the main range of the [Quercion pubescenti-petraeae], as well as a few highly xero-thermic central European sites. [Prunus mahaleb] and [Acer monspessulanum] are characteristic species.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Rock pear scrub
description: Possibly primary scrub formations of the Hercynian ranges and their vicinity, the Jura, the Alpine periphery and Alpine inner valleys, with [Cotoneaster integerrimus], [Cotoneaster tomentosus] and [Amelanchier ovalis] developed on very shallow soils between [Xerobromion] grasslands and open xerothermic oak woods.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Peri-Alpine sea buckthorn-barberry scrub
description: Shrub formations characterized by the physiognomically distinctive presence of [Hippophae rhamnoides] ssp. [fluviatilis] or [Hippophae rhamnoides] ssp. [carpatica], rich in xerothermophile species, colonizing dry shingle terraces, no longer subjected to flooding, of peri-Alpine water courses.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Inner Alpine barberry scrub
description: Thorny heaths of inner Alpine valleys with [Berberis vulgaris].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Inner Alpine marmot plum scrub
description: Shrub formations of inner Alpine valleys of the western Alpine system, with [Prunus brigantina].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Inner Alpine rose-barberry scrubs
description: Thorny shrub formations of sunny slopes of inner Alpine valleys, most characteristic of the upper Engadine and the Vintschgau, with irradiations in the western Austrian upper Inn Valley and the eastern Tyrolian Virgental.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Iberian barberry scrub
description: Northwestern Iberian montane communities with [Berberis vulgaris] ssp. [cantabrica], [Prunus spinosa], [Corylus avellana], [Sorbus aria], [Taxus baccata], [Crataegus monogyna], [Ribes alpinum], [Ribes petraeum], [Rhamnus alpinus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Box thickets
description: Box-dominated formations of units 31.81, 31.89, 31.8A or 31.8B.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Atlantic poor soil thickets
description: Deciduous thickets of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe formed by [Rubus spp.], [Frangula alnus], [Sorbus aucuparia], [Corylus avellana], [Lonicera periclymenum], [Cytisus scoparius], characteristic of forest edges, hedges and woodland recolonization developed on soils relatively poor in nutrients, usually acid, mostly under climates with strong Atlantic influence, substitution communities of the [Quercion robori-petraeae] (units 41.51-41.56, 41.57 [p.], 41.58 [p.]).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Bramble thickets
description: Atlantic deciduous thickets of poor soils of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe dominated by [Rubus spp.], including British [Rubus fruticosus]-[Holcus lanatus] underscrub.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alder buckthorn, rowan, honeysuckle thickets
description: Atlantic deciduous thickets of poor soils of Western Europe and western and northern Central Europe dominated by [Frangula alnus], [Sorbus aucuparia], [Lonicera periclymenum] or other shrubs, with the exception of brambles (genus [Rubus]), included in unit 31.831, or of brooms (genus [Cytisus]), gorse ([Ulex europaeus]), hazel ([Corylus avellana]), bracken ([Pteridium aquilinum]), separately covered in units 31.84, 31.85, 31.8C1, 31.861, respectively.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Broom fields
description: Medio-European and sub-Mediterranean formations with an upper stratum dominated by tall brooms.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Medio-European [Cytisus scoparius] fields
description: Expanses of broom ([Cytisus scoparius]), a common recolonization stage of the [Quercion] in the plains and hills of northern and middle Europe, reaching the montane zone in the higher mountains.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Lowland and hill broom fields
description: [Cytisus scoparius] fields of the lowlands, hills and low mountains of northern, western and central Europe.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Alpine broom fields
description: Montane [Cytisus scoparius] fields of the Alpine system.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Central Massif [Cytisus scoparius] fields
description: Montane beech-level formations of [Cytisus scoparius] of the Central Massif.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Pyrenean [Cytisus scoparius] fields
description: Montane formations of [Cytisus scoparius] of the Pyrenees.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: [Cytisus purgans]-dominated formations of higher levels (upper montane, subalpine, oromediterranean) of southwestern European and North African mountains, often associated with dwarf juniper scrubs (unit 31.43) or hedgehog-heaths (unit 31.7), and physiognomically reminiscent of the latter.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Cévennes [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Localized formations of the upper levels of the C‚vennes.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Pyrenean [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Upper montane Pyrenean formations appearing on the edge of, or as substitution of, acidophilous pine woods.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Galicio-Cantabrian [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Galician and oro-Cantabrian upper montane formations.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Upper Cordilleran [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Alti-Mediterranean and oro-Mediterranean formations of the Cordillera Central.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Lower Cordilleran [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Upper supra-Mediterrranean formations of the Cordillera Central.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Galicio-Leonese [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Oro-Mediterranean formations of the high southern Galicio-Leonese sierras.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Nevadan [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: Oro-Mediterranean formations of the Sierra Nevada.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: North African [Cytisus purgans] fields
description: [Cytisus purgans]-dominated formations of higher levels (upper montane, subalpine, oromediterranean) of North African mountains.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Piornales
description: [Cytisus multiflorus], [Cytisus striatus], [Cytisus scoparius], [Cytisus grandiflorus], [Cytisus cantabricus], [Genista florida] and other tall broom fields of the Iberian peninsula, mostly characteristic of the transition between the Atlantic and Mediterranean domaines.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: White-flowered broom fields
description: Formations rich in white-flowered [Cytisus multiflorus] of the western Meseta, the (mostly western) Cordillera Central, the sierras of southern Galicia and Leon and the western Cantabrian mountains, in which [Cytisus multiflorus] is either the only tall broom or is an important component of broom fields also containing yellow-flowered [Genista florida] ssp. [polygaliphylla], [Genista florida] ssp. [florida], [Genista cinerea] ssp. [cinerascens], [Cytisus scoparius] and others.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Northwestern Iberian [Genista florida] fields
description: Formations rich in [Genista florida] ssp. [polygaliphylla] of the oro-Cantabrian region, the sierras of southern Galicia and Leon, the Serra da Estrela, the northern Iberian range, with [Cytisus cantabricus], [Cytisus scoparius], [Cytisus striatus], [Genista obtusiramea], [Adenocarpus complicatus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Northwestern Iberian [Cytisus] fields
description: Formations rich in [Cytisus striatus] or [Cytisus ingramii] of the western Cordillera Central and of Galician hills and plateaux, with [Genista florida] ssp. [polygaliphylla], [Cytisus scoparius], [Cytisus multiflorus] or [Ulex europaeus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Central Iberian [Genista florida] fields
description: Formations rich in [Genista florida] ssp. [florida] of the Cordillera Central and the Southern Iberian Range with [Cytisus scoparius], [Cytisus multiflorus], [Cytisus striatus], [Genista cinerea] ssp. [cinerascens], [Adenocarpus hispanicus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Upper Cordilleran [Genista cinerea] fields
description: Formations dominated by [Genista cinerea] ssp. [cinerascens] of higher elevations of the Cordillera Central.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Central Iberian [Cytisus] fields
description: Formations rich in [Cytisus striatus] or [Cytisus scoparius] of the Cordillera Central and the Montes de Toledo with [Genista florida] ssp. [florida] or [Chamaespartium tridentatum].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Andalusian broom fields
description: Formations of [Cytisus reverchonii], [Cytisus grandiflorus], [Adenocarpus decorticans] of the supra-Mediterranean zone of Andalucian mountains.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Tyrrhenian broom fields
description: Broom fields of peninsular Italy and of the large Tyrrhenian islands.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Peninsular Italian broom fields
description: Supra-Mediterranean and montane peninsular formations with [Cytisus scoparius], [Cytisus sessilifolius] or [Adenocarpus complicatus].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Insular Tyrrhenian broom fields
description: Supra-Mediterranean and montane formations of Corsica, Sardinia and Sicily with [Cytisus scoparius].
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: [Genista aetnensis] stands
description: Formations of the very large [Genista aetnensis], endemic to the western Mediterranean and of considerable biogeographical interest, with a distribution limited to Sicily and Sardinia. The species has been introduced on Vesuvio, where it also forms extensive stands.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Etna [Genista aetnensis] stands
description: Formations of [Genista aetnensis] colonizing the lava fields of the eastern flank of Mount Etna.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Sardinian [Genista aetnensis] stands
description: Very rare and localized [Genista aetnensis] formations of Sardinia (east and Iglesiente).
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Canary Island broom fields
description: Canary Island formations with [Teline spp.], [Micromeria spp.], [Adenocarpus foliolosus] developed in particular in the humid montane zone where they replace heaths on sunnier exposures.
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: North African broom fields
description: Broom fields of the supra-mediterranean zone of North African mountains, in particular, fields of [Genista cinerea] ssp. [cinerea], of [Teline monspessulana], [Cytisus batandieri] dominated formations of humid slopes of the Great Atlas at the 1500-1800 m level, [Adenocarpus spp.] and [Cytisus spp.]
source: Devillers, P., Devillers-Terschuren, J. & Vander Linden, C., 2001. PHYSIS Palaearctic Habitat Classification, updated to 10 December 2001 (IRSNB); table TYPO_PAL_PHYSIS_2001, SPN-MNHN / INPN 2010

name: Atlas [Cytisus battandieri] broom fields
description: Broom fields of the supramediterranean zone of humid slopes of the Great Atlas, at the 1500-1800 m level, dominated by [Cytisus battandieri], with [Cytisus villosus] ([Cytisus triflorus]), [Cistus salviifolius], [Cistus villosus] var. [mauritanicus].
